Subject: POC trial: success criteria & stakeholder RACI (HorizonCare)

Hi Priya / Sam 

Great to meet you both on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment heading into the POC: 

1) POC objective and success criteria (proposed)
- Validate inference latency at 95th percentile under expected concurrency (target < 250ms)
- Cost per 1k tokens below $0.45 with Redwood batching/quantization guidance
- End-to-end accuracy on our eval set: intent extraction F1 >= 0.86
- Integration sanity: app can call Redwood API and receive streaming responses without errors for 10k+ tokens/day

2) Evaluation plan
- Redwood provides a lightweight test harness and sample prompts (we'll ask for a small dataset or synthetic examples)
- HorizonCare runs 1-week functional validation, 2-week load evaluation (3 weeks total)
- Weekly checkpoints to review metrics and logs; final evaluation report at end of week 3

3) Timeline (proposed)
- Kickoff and environment access: week of Apr 6
- Functional validation: Apr 6–Apr 12
- Load/throughput evaluation: Apr 13–Apr 26
- Wrap & decision: Apr 27–May 1

4) Ownership / RACI (what we need from you)  please confirm the internal owners so we can update the RACI:
- Infra (network/VPC, firewall rules, test data access)  proposed: HorizonCare IT
- Application integration (calling APIs, auth, routing)  proposed: HorizonCare App Team
- Security/compliance (questionnaire, evidence, KMS)  proposed: HorizonCare Security
- Procurement / PO / contract signoff  proposed: Procurement/Finance

Attachments: redwood_poc_scope.pdf (draft scope), raci-template.xlsx (editable).

Ask: Can you confirm the named owners for infra, app, security and procurement + any preferred kickoff dates? Once confirmed we will schedule the kickoff and spin up a dedicated trial environment (Redwood Dedicated capacity reserved).

Thanks  looking forward to running this with you.


Marissa Cole
